name: Downgrade the Complete Edition to 1.0.7.0
description: Replaces the Complete Edition game files with the 1.0.7.0 build. Measured against a 1.2.0.59 installation: 58 files get replaced, 88 are added, 40 already match in size. Radio songs Rockstar removed from the Complete Edition do NOT come back. What stays behind is exclusively Rockstar Launcher leftovers (MTLX.dll, index.bin, metadata.dat, title.rgl, uninstall.exe) - no game data. The 1.0.7.0 game does not read them, and it is started directly via GTAIV.exe anyway.

sources.note: Game files for 1.0.7.0, 232 entries. Hosted as a GitHub release of the Gillian guide project. The packages of the ClonkAndre downgrader lived in a Dropbox and are no longer retrievable there. Cross-check: the GTAIV.exe inside (SHA-256 ab21c0d90d2ca1c697785aca9dcf44635e1f8d48aa0df1d737e9190bddf0cb4c, 15505792 bytes) is byte-identical to the one from an independently obtained Retail-1070.zip.
